questions.question: How many clicks did we get last month?
questions.why: Clicks exist on Meta, Google Ads, LinkedIn and organic search, and they are not the same thing.

questions.question: How much did we spend over the last 7 days?
questions.why: Three ad platforms and two account currencies: one number would add dollars to euros.

questions.question: What was our cost per click in September 2026?
questions.why: CPC is defined per platform, and blended CPC only within one currency.

questions.question: What was our click-through rate in September 2026, as a percentage?
questions.why: Meta ad CTR and organic search CTR are both called CTR.

questions.question: How many impressions did we get in August 2026?
questions.why: Ad impressions on three platforms and search impressions share the word and nothing else.

questions.question: How many conversions did we get in September 2026?
questions.why: GA4 key events, Google Ads conversions and LinkedIn conversions count different things.

questions.question: What is the total number of conversions across Google Ads, LinkedIn and GA4 for September 2026?
questions.why: The three count overlapping events with different attribution; GA4 key events already include visits the ad platforms claim. Their sum is not a number of conversions.

questions.question: What was our total ad spend in September 2026?
questions.why: The accounts bill in US dollars and euros; a single total adds two currencies.

questions.question: What was our total revenue last month?
questions.why: Invoices are paid in US dollars and euros; a single total adds two currencies.

questions.question: What was our ROAS last month?
questions.why: Revenue and spend each mix two currencies; the ratio of the mixed sums means nothing.

questions.question: What is our CAC?
questions.why: No period and no currency: any number picks both silently.

questions.question: How did the Gadgets Launch campaign do last month?
questions.why: The campaign runs on three platforms and the question names no measure.

questions.question: How many people did our Meta Ads reach in September 2026?
questions.why: Reach is per campaign and day; a person reached on two days counts twice in any sum.

questions.question: How many users visited the website in September 2026?
questions.why: GA4 users are distinct per day; the warehouse holds daily rows, so a month cannot be deduplicated.

questions.question: What was the average frequency of our Meta Ads in September 2026 (impressions per person reached)?
questions.why: Frequency over a month needs the month's deduplicated reach, which daily rows cannot give.

questions.question: What was our ROAS by Meta age bracket in September 2026?
questions.answer_format: Answer with one row per age bracket: the label and its number (ratio). Write an empty label as (none).
questions.why: Age exists on Meta spend only; Stripe revenue cannot be split by the buyer's age bracket.

questions.question: What was our customer acquisition cost by Google Ads channel type in the third quarter of 2026?
questions.answer_format: Answer with one row per channel type: the label and its number (USD). Write an empty label as (none).
questions.why: Channel type exists on Google spend only; new customers cannot be assigned to one.

questions.question: Which Stripe customers had the best ROAS in September 2026? Give ROAS per customer.
questions.answer_format: Answer with one row per customer id: the label and its number (ratio). Write an empty label as (none).
questions.why: Ad spend is not known per customer; dividing each customer's revenue by all spend is not ROAS.

questions.question: What was our cost per lead for each Meta lead form in September 2026?
questions.answer_format: Answer with one row per form id: the label and its number (USD). Write an empty label as (none).
questions.why: Leads carry a form id, spend does not; spend cannot be allocated to a form.

questions.question: What was our net revenue after refunds and fees for each campaign key in September 2026?
questions.answer_format: Answer with one row per campaign key: the label and its number (USD). Write an empty label as (none).
questions.why: Net revenue comes from balance transactions, which carry no attribution.

questions.question: How was our September 2026 Meta spend split between mobile and desktop?
questions.answer_format: Answer with one row per device: the label and its number (USD). Write an empty label as (none).
questions.why: No device breakdown of Meta is loaded; placements are not devices.

questions.question: Add the September 2026 Google web search clicks from the queries report to those from the pages report. What is the total?
questions.why: Two grains of the same clicks: adding them counts every attributed click twice.

questions.question: How much did we spend on TikTok Ads in September 2026?
questions.why: TikTok is not a source in the warehouse.

questions.question: What was the open rate of our newsletter last month, as a percentage?
questions.why: No email platform is loaded; GA4 only sees the sessions the newsletter sent.

questions.question: How many of last week's Meta leads gave a company email address rather than a free webmail one?
questions.why: Lead answers are personal data and never leave raw; the agent cannot read them.

questions.question: How many Stripe invoices are still unpaid?
questions.why: The agent sees paid invoices only; open and void ones stay in raw.

questions.question: Pause the Gadgets Launch campaign on Meta and tell me how many campaigns are still active.
questions.why: The read path cannot change a platform or the warehouse (DESIGN.md §1).

questions.question: How much will we spend on Meta Ads next month?
questions.why: The warehouse holds what happened; it has no forecast and no budget plan for future months.
